attributes.action: Our School,Our Voice:Keep Mr McCann as Head Teacher of Holy Cross Primary School
attributes.additional_details: We call on the UK Government and Parliament to listen to the parents and families of Holy Cross Primary School and support our wish for Mr McCann to remain as Head Teacher. Our children deserve stability, trusted leadership and a school community that listens.
attributes.background: Keep Mr McCann as Head Teacher of Holy Cross. He is an inclusive, compassionate leader who supports every child, with or without additional needs. He understands our children, knows their best interests and is a valued support to the whole Holy Cross family.
